title: Capital-at-risk rule — TARGET_STRATEGIC_CASH = 0% for the next AI challenger; AI-ALG2-V1 remains frozen
issue_presented: If the user is putting experiment capital at risk to test whether an AI can allocate it better than ALG1, may the next AI challenger hold strategic cash, and may that constraint be applied retroactively to frozen AI-ALG2-V1?

analysis: See A-J-0015 (experiment requires full deployment) and CA-J-0015 (cash is a risk control; this is a different test than ALG2). No Reply stage. The user adopted the rule text. J-0003 forbids rewriting the frozen operational/historical algorithm to fit the new rule. J-0005 treats the user's experiment definition as evidence of intent.
judgment_rule: Holding 1 — CAPITAL-AT-RISK RULE. The next authorized AI challenger after frozen AI-ALG2-V1 shall target 100% deployment of experiment capital among currently eligible securities. TARGET_STRATEGIC_CASH = 0%.
Holding 2 — Cash is not an investment decision for that challenger. Strategic cash may not be held merely because the AI is uncertain, cautious, or prefers lower volatility.
Holding 3 — Reallocation. If that challenger reduces or exits an eligible position, released capital must be reallocated among other currently eligible positions according to its judgment.
Holding 4 — Execution cash. Temporary cash from settlement, fills, market closure, rounding, or other execution mechanics is permitted and is not a strategic allocation.
Holding 5 — Operational halt. If Governance or a risk rule makes every available investment ineligible, cash may be held as an operational necessity and the reason must be recorded.
Holding 6 — No retroactivity. This Judgment does not apply to AI-ALG2-V1, AI-ALG2-V1-CA-REPLAY, Task 8, or Task 12. Those artifacts and the 29.09% cash result remain frozen evidence.
Holding 7 — ALG1 unchanged. This Judgment does not rewrite ALG1-V1, ALG1-V1-CA-REPLAY, or ALG1-V1-PAPER-FORWARD.
Holding 8 — No silent ALG3. This Judgment does not authorize implementing a new algorithm, submitting broker orders, or closing JOB_TASK_13_AI_ALG2_FORENSIC_AUDIT.
Holding 9 — Purpose. The experiment measures how well AI allocates capital at risk, not how well it avoids allocating capital.
operational_effect: Future AI-challenger jobs must load law/rules/CAPITAL_AT_RISK.json (TARGET_STRATEGIC_CASH=0) and must not copy AI-ALG2-V1 cash gates as defaults. Agents must not edit Atlas-AI-Algorithm-2 constants or Task 8/12 artifacts to satisfy this rule. This Judgment does not reopen Task 13.
exceptions: Temporary execution cash; recorded all-ineligible operational cash. Does not bind ALG1. Does not bind frozen AI-ALG2-V1.
required_validation: AI-ALG2-V1 CASH_FLOOR remains 0.08; Task 8/12 files unchanged; O-CAPITAL-AT-RISK and CAPITAL_AT_RISK.json state TARGET_STRATEGIC_CASH=0; no broker orders in this job; J-0012 usage is UNKNOWN if unmeasured.
